dependencies: Required whole nhlsel.c:l_selection_setpoint158–199: resolve zero/one/two/three-or-more argument forms, use get_location_coord with ANY_LOC and the current coder room/frame, preserve returned selection identity and numeric value. The existing ThemeroomSelection.set only handles explicit coordinates and Booleanizes values. The zero-argument C wrapper allocates but leaves sel NULL and raises Selection setpoint error; preserve this source behavior rather than following its outdated comment.

Required whole pure nhlsel.c:l_selection_or305–328: allocate a result, combine operand bounds using existing pure rect.c:rect_bounds133–140, traverse x-major, store getpoint(a) bitwise OR getpoint(b), preserve operands and source bounds behavior. No existing l_selection_or or union helper was found by rg in js/.

Shared dependency: selvar.c:selection_getpoint168–178 and selection_setpoint181–210 retain numeric values through source char(c+1) storage, while JS get/set/selection_clear reduce values to Boolean. B200 Tou-goal subtraction and C176 Tou-loca OR/subtraction require the same numeric selection contract. Main must assign the exact supporting storage scope once; B202 cannot independently edit this seam. A196 Val-loca and C177 Val-goal confirmed no setpoint/OR/numeric-storage dependency.

Existing js/room_coordinates.js:get_location_coord/get_location cover packed random coordinates, ANY_LOC and coder frame. A minimal scoped mklev createSpecialLevelApi selection binding must pass its actual state/coder/frame into the source helper; do not duplicate RNG or sample the later map dimensions. No room_coordinates owner edit is initially proposed.

Existing selection_new/clone/grow and des terrain/map owners must preserve absolute pre-map selections, source W_RANDOM direction order and ignored x map cells. Existing level_flags icedpools must precede level_init; sel_set_ter sets icedpool metadata only on ICE, without converting P into ice.

Existing lspo_monster custom inventory and lspo_object/ONAME context support the Norn inventory callback, chest, source name/gender parsing, fixed-coordinate hostile giants and equipment finalization. Existing branch/stair/feature/door/non_diggable/trap/finalization owners are consumed in source order; any newly reached runtime refusal requires a scoped source gate before editing.

evidence: Current saved challenges/evaluations/accepted-b25f66f0e26a48c63aa915bb2d0e225b7bdeb3e0-v36.json has 19/60 screens and cursors, 2205/2942 RNG: 41 remaining screens over 60 steps. Manifest digest 58332ee9786ee7c91f282d2fe29ca64fc6ee5e23ca70f0261bbedd7ea88fd20c is the queue/evaluation digest; recipe SHA c95b86e0f842d5772b63621ec8a8c7b1a5f61e6ae4d6ffbabc7781ebfb75ff3b and recording SHA bd018419e6b072d055d445683d58fddf50dd9a14c43ee1d19997ab1149a3f571 were independently verified. No replay, aggregate scan or new C recording was run for this source diagnosis.

Read whole dat/Val-strt.lua, source SHA 33bc072378baf232f08fe3ca819ffdfe7e55d8c52fa0ac291a6d2512054b608e. It sets mazelevel, noteleport, hardfloor and icedpools before solidfill I; initial unspecified lit consumes rn2(2). It then constructs the lava/water selections before loading the 20-row, 76-column map. Map x cells are INVALID_TYPE and skip writes, preserving the prepainted field and cells outside the overlay.

Source lines 16–24 make 13 independent random points and three additional points grown west, north and random. Step 19 records sixteen rn2(79),rn2(21) pairs, followed by rn2(4)=3 at random_wdir. The initial frame is xstart=1,ystart=0,xsize=79,ysize=21; the second point uses y=20 outside the later 20-row map. Repeated points are allowed: no uniqueness filtering or selection removal appears in C.

The recorded point draws are (55,12),(11,20),(67,14),(74,10),(1,7),(70,7),(2,2),(53,7),(41,13),(49,13),(59,8),(61,5),(42,4),(20,16),(68,19),(52,3); actual x adds initial xstart=1. random_wdir source4581 indexes NORTH,SOUTH,EAST,WEST, so the final growth is west. These are diagnostic data; implementation must derive every draw from source and generalize across seeds.

Source lines 27–28 paint the cloned all-direction growth P, then original pools L. nhlsel.c:l_selection_grow631–653 clones before selection_do_grow; selvar.c322–367 expands cardinal/diagonal neighborhoods without changing its source operand. Existing ThemeroomSelection.grow matches this clone/direction structure, but whole OR/setpoint results cannot be replaced by a Boolean-only approximation.

Source map is followed by full-map lit region, branch arrival66/17, downstair18/1, fountain53/2, locked doors26/10 and43/10. Norn35/10 receives banded mail spe5 and long sword spe4 through the custom inventory callback, then a chest is created36/10. Eight warriors surround the audience chamber; only26/7..43/13 is non-diggable. Preserve source placement/finalization order and allow_flips; do not add an absent wallify statement.

Source then creates six random fire traps, ten fixed fire ants and two explicitly hostile fire giants18/1 and10/16, yielding21 monster descriptors. Keep source string/table forms to preserve species/gender/location RNG. Read upstream lspo_monster/create_monster and existing canonical callback handling; monster inventory preparation must remain before the source callback and equipment finalization after it.

The missing helper search rg -n l_selection_or|l_selection_setpoint js/ returned no matches. Existing ThemeroomSelection.set stores value?1:0, get returns nonzero as Boolean and selection_clear also Booleanizes. C OR instead combines integer point values; source set/get store char(c+1) and recover mapcell-1. A coherent numeric owner must audit all reads/writes and preserve Boolean consumers without duplicating cell state. Whole helper credit requires source-pinned numeric cases, input preservation, empty bounds and byte behavior.

Whole l_selection_setpoint and l_selection_or were read, including consumed pure rect_bounds and existing get_location_coord. Setpoint is impure because random argument forms consume RNG and mutate the selection. OR is pure for game evidence: it changes only its newly allocated result and Lua stack, with no RNG, message, screen or game-state mutation. Required tests must pin full argument/error behavior and numeric OR rather than testing only Val-strt Boolean points.

Independent evidence plan after authorization: two C-first human Valkyrie arrivals with different relevant character/input history and #wizmap, verifying initial ice metadata, lava/water ring, ignored-map preservation, leader inventory, locked doors, branch/downstairs, protected hall and six traps. Source-pinned generated map and descriptor order, pre-map 79x21 random-coordinate bounds, selection identity/OR/input preservation and initial flags must accompany fully matching recordings. Cite admitted segment0 steps19–59 only after implementation replay matches that range.

Smallest proposed program scope is unique valStrt import/function/registry entry in quest_levels.js, deterministic generated val_strt_level_data/generator/check, required selection helpers in established themerooms.js owner and a bounded mklev API binding. Main must first adjudicate shared numeric storage with B200/C176. No initial display/zap/monster/room-coordinate owner edits, no helper completion inferred from declarations, and no implementation claim or game edit has been made. Preserve B195 pending ancestor and every parked report.
